about-me-section.title: About Me
about-me-section.description:
Software Developer focused on Back-End and data management.

I am passionate about understanding how data flows within systems and transforming it into efficient and secure solutions.

Experience in environments with MySQL, Java, C#, Qlik Sense, etc., participating in data migration, integration, and analysis processes.

I stand out for my fast learning ability and for keeping calm in demanding environments. I am looking to keep growing in projects where data and the backend are the core of innovation.
